Close a zero-total bill with netting payments and verify AUC in the RQ payload and AUCUN PAIEMENT on the bill.
Attempt payment with an expired DEV certificate and verify refusal before bill delivery.
Attempt customer-failed-to-pay deletion with an expired DEV certificate and prove the invoice remains intact.
Produce a bill with a DEV certificate tax-identity mismatch and verify CERTIFICAT INVALIDE and NE PAS REMETTRE AU CLIENT.
Close a bill with a modifier description truncated at a space boundary and verify no trailing space in the RQ item.
Close a bill with no printable item and verify one SOB item and AUC payment in the accepted RQ payload.
